newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Natural Gas sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Natural Gas sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Northwest Natural Gas Co said said it expects to report a third quarter loss of $0.15 to $0.20 per share, on a pre-split basis.
It will split its shares three-for-two on September 6.

It said the expected loss compares with a loss of $0.34 per share in last year's third quarter and will incorporate a new accounting method, which shifts more demand charges in the first and the fourth quarters. The company also said it expects to report a fourth quarter profit of $1.05 to $1.10 per share, down from $1.29 in the year ago period, with the drop due partly to the new accounting procedures.

Based on these forecasts, the company said it is comfortable with analyst forecasts of earnings in of $0.85 to $0.95 per share in the second half of fiscal 1996. It said these forecasts assume average weather conditions.
